doc: Unit readability on the battle board (BattleBoard.gd). Alphas are 0..1 (1 = opaque). 'border' sprites are the background / border trees, bushes, foliage and ground decoration drawn around and over the arena (outer ring). A border sprite whose (shrunk) screen rect overlaps the playable tiles is drawn at border_alpha; if a unit is behind it (the sprite is drawn after the unit and their rects overlap) it fades to border_behind_alpha. Sprites completely outside the board stay opaque. Blocking obstacles on the board stay solid and only fade to obstacle_behind_alpha while a unit is directly behind them; small decoration on the board fades to decor_behind_alpha. Tall grass cover is left as it is. fade_speed = how fast alphas tween (per second, exponential): ~8 = about 0.12 s.
